jobs.title: Director of Information Technology
jobs.description:
About Our Client:

The organization operates within the technology sector, focusing on designing and securing infrastructure for its clients. It addresses the challenge of maintaining high standards for internal technology environments in a remote-first setting, ensuring that its own operations reflect the quality delivered to clients. The company integrates AI governance and security practices to enhance both internal and client-facing technology solutions.

About the Opportunity:

The DIRECTOR OF INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY is responsible for leading and managing the internal technology environment. This role involves setting the technology strategy, building and developing the IT team, and overseeing the adoption and governance of AI within the organization. The position plays a vital role in ensuring that the internal IT infrastructure operates at the same high standard as client-facing solutions, contributing to overall organizational effectiveness and security.

Responsibilities:

Develop and execute a multi-year internal technology roadmap covering identity, endpoints, networking, collaboration, and service management
Align technology investments with business outcomes and define success metrics
Determine which IT functions are handled internally versus through partners
Establish IT governance, standards, architecture review, and change management processes
Design and build the internal IT team, including headcount planning and hiring
Mentor the team and define ownership, on-call, and escalation procedures
Develop an internal service catalog with defined service levels
Lead internal AI tool development, rollout, training, and adoption measurement
Collaborate with AI practice teams to inform client delivery
Manage AI financial engineering, including cost modeling and consumption forecasting
Oversee endpoint management and device lifecycle processes
Manage Microsoft 365 collaboration tools and enforce device requirements for a remote workforce
Own internal network architecture, remote access, and secure connectivity
Manage cloud and hosting resources, including capacity and cost
Ensure backup, recovery, and business continuity with tested recovery objectives
Establish and mature IT service management processes
Publish operational metrics and reduce employee friction points
Manage onboarding and offboarding technology experiences with HR
Oversee IT budget, forecasting, and software license management
Rationalize SaaS applications and manage vendor relationships and contracts
Partner with security leadership to execute security programs and support compliance audits
Manage vulnerability assessment and remediation for internal systems

Requirements:

Minimum 10 years in information technology with leadership or technology ownership experience
Proven ability to build and scale IT in a distributed or remote-first fast-growth environment
Experience presenting technology strategies and metrics to executives
Expertise in Microsoft 365, Entra ID, endpoint management (Intune or equivalent), and SaaS at scale
Experience with internal AI adoption, governance, and change management
Strong security knowledge and ability to collaborate with CISOs and communicate risks to executives
Experience in solutions providers, MSPs, or consulting preferred
Familiarity with audit, SOC 2, or regulated compliance processes
Vendor management, contract negotiation, and budget experience
Effective communication skills with technical and executive audiences
Industry certifications such as ITIL, Microsoft, CISSP/CISM, PMP are valued but not required

Pay Range and Compensation Package:

The pay range and compensation package for this role will be determined based on the candidate's experience, skills, and other relevant factors.

Benefits & Perks:

Medical Insurance
Dental Insurance
Vision Insurance
401(k) retirement plan with company match (annual dollar cap applied)
Flexible time off plan
15 paid holidays
Sick leave (compliant with state requirements)
Short-term and long-term disability
Life insurance
Paid parental leave

Equal Opportunity Statement:
Our client is an equal opportunity employer. They celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or national origin.

Note:

RemoteHunter is a recruitment partner of this role. Please note that all employment decisions, including candidate assessment, interviews, hiring, compensation, and employment terms, are made exclusively by the hiring employer.

jobs.title: Senior IT Manager, Change Management & Project Management Office
jobs.description:
Job Description:

The Senior IT Manager for Change Management and Project Management Office is responsible for driving organizational transformation through effective change management strategies and ensuring successful delivery of IT projects. This role oversees the Project Management Office, establishes governance frameworks, and aligns initiatives with business objectives to maximize value and minimize risk. This role ensures successful delivery of complex technology programs, fosters adoption of new processes and systems, and aligns IT projects with enterprise objectives. This position will champion digital transformation, innovation, and a culture of agility across the organization. The position serves as a key liaison between IT leadership, business stakeholders, and project teams to foster a culture of agility, accountability, and continuous improvement.

PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

Lead the Project Management Office, establishing governance frameworks and portfolio management processes.
Oversee the project and work intake process to ensure the alignment of IT projects with business priorities, ensuring optimal resource allocation and value delivery.
Define and execute the global change management strategy for IT and business initiatives.
Develop and implement change management plans to support the adoption of new technologies and processes.
Partner with business units to assess change impacts and design communication, training, and engagement strategies.
Establish PMO standards, methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, hybrid), and best practices.
Oversee end-to-end project lifecycle management, ensuring compliance with risk, quality, and regulatory requirements.
Manage project portfolio performance, including prioritization, budgeting, and vendor oversight.
Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on change and project management matters.
Facilitate cross-functional collaboration and resolve escalated issues impacting delivery.
Communicate progress, risks, and outcomes to executive stakeholders with clarity and transparency.
Build and mentor a high-performing team of project managers and change management professionals.
Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement within the PMO and with business partners.
Work with the business process owners to standardize the technology platform and support processes for regional and global IT systems
Develop proposals, statements of work, business requirements documents, resource planning and project plans
Drive process automation and effective management to replace manual operations and create efficiencies
Drive IT risk, security, and compliance awareness as part of the project and ongoing business processes.
Support the business stakeholders in management and definition of business requirements for systems including enhancements and new functions
Identify and manage risks and issues proactively, including resources, costs, and systems, and recommend appropriate solutions.
Review and assist in the development and delivery of system and process training to the user community through webinars, videos, knowledge base, and other employee engagement practices
Define and publish regular IT Project and change management metrics and KPIs
Monitor change readiness and adoption metrics, reporting progress to executive leadership.
Other duties as assigned

PERSON SPECIFICATION:
(minimum education requirements, key skills and experience)

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant technology, engineering, aviation/transportation, or computer science field or relevant experience

Experience:

15+ years’ of experience within Information Technology: supporting systems, people and processes
Experience leading, managing, and delivering projects, managing both external clients/stakeholders and internal leaders and project teams
Extensive experience with ERP platforms (SAP, Oracle, Dynamics 365), ITSM tools (ServiceNow), HRIS (Workday) and PPM tools (MS Project, Planner, Monday).
Experience with managing and leading Projects
Expertise in Project Management concepts (certification preferred)
Experience with the Solution Development Life Cycle (SDLC) process
Experience with IT Infrastructure Library (ITIL) framework, especially around Change & Release Management
Experience with IT organizational and business change management concepts (certification preferred)

Skills:

Ability to translate business requirements into technology requirements
Strong strategic vision with a hands-on approach to operational excellence.
Excellent leadership and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence at all organizational levels.
Proven ability to manage budgets, drive cost savings, and achieve IT ROI
Microsoft Office Intermediate skills
Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) Toolsets: MS Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, etc
Excellent Presentation Skills
Results-oriented and continuous improvement mindset
Strong verbal and written communication skills at all levels, including with leadership and management
Highly organized with the ability to organize own workload
Highly motivated with the skills and temperament to function effectively and efficiently in a Corporate environment
Exhibit a high level of integrity and confidentiality
Ability to keep a level head when working under pressure
Dedicated to promoting a positive image of the organization
Ability to work and manage remote teams
Proactive and enthusiastic, with a willingness to roll up your sleeves
Ability to travel to various operational locations as requested

jobs.title: Director of Technology
jobs.description:
Pandi, LLC
is an SEC-registered investment adviser (“RIA”) and multi-family office based in Kansas City. We provide portfolio management and investment advisory services for families, individuals, trusts, and institutions, including private foundations and private companies owned by our family clients.
Our advisory services primarily consist of: (a) defining overall investment strategy, (b) setting strategic asset allocation targets, (c) selecting, underwriting, and monitoring specific investments, and (d) ensuring our clients have a holistic view of performance for their investment portfolios. We also provide financial consulting and other related family office services to our clients.
The Director of Technology shall define and lead the execution of the technology strategy, cybersecurity posture, and technology operations for Pandi with a focus on leveraging artificial intelligence to automate workflows across investment operations, compliance, reporting, and client service.
This role ensures that information technology systems, infrastructure, and data platforms effectively support business objectives while meeting the operational, security, and regulatory requirements of an SEC-regulated investment firm as well as the needs of its clients’ technology environments. The role combines hands-on technical leadership with strategic oversight of the technology team. In addition to core infrastructure, network, and security responsibilities, the Director will lead the evaluation, governance, and controlled implementation of emerging technologies, including building internal applications and workflows that leverage existing artificial intelligence (“AI”) platforms, while ensuring their use aligns with confidentiality obligations, compliance expectations, and risk tolerance.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Define and execute an organization-wide technology, cybersecurity, data resiliency, and AI strategy that delivers cost-effective, best-in-class services, including governance and risk oversight across Pandi and multiple client entities, including the Patterson Family Foundation and First Hand Foundation.
Serve as a hands-on technology leader by implementing, maintaining, and troubleshooting systems directly while managing, mentoring, and developing the technology team.
Establish and oversee a secure, scalable technology environment leveraging modern cloud productivity, identity, networking, and security platforms to support collaboration, access management, and secure operations in a regulated environment.
Oversee the security of systems, networks, applications, and enterprise data in a cloud-first environment, applying zero-trust architecture and the principle of least privilege across identity, network, and application layers.
Prepare, maintain, and manage annual technology financial plans, including forecasting and cost optimization as well as contract management for technology systems.
Provide regular reporting to Pandi leadership and clients on technology projects, initiatives, security posture, and risks.
Build and maintain data infrastructure—pipelines, warehouses, APIs—that enables advanced analytics and AI integration.
Architect and implement AI-powered workflow automation across core business functions including investment research, portfolio monitoring, compliance reporting, and client communications; stay current on AI developments and proactively identify automation opportunities.
Develop, maintain, and test business continuity and disaster recovery plans, ensuring operational resilience and documented recovery procedures.
Ensure data classification, protection, retention, auditability, and lifecycle management of all enterprise content, including collaboration platforms and AI-enabled systems.
Facilitate and support information technology security audits, reviews, investigations, and ongoing monitoring, leveraging centralized enterprise logging and visibility solutions (e.g., SIEM platforms); continuously improve change management, approval, and documentation processes to ensure controlled, auditable technology changes.
In partnership with the Chief Compliance Officer (CCO), maintain acceptable use standards, data handling requirements, and access controls for effective monitoring and oversight of AI usage; ensure IT operations meet SEC regulatory requirements for registered investment advisers.
Develop and maintain relationships with external information technology vendors and service providers and conduct vendor due diligence and ongoing technology risk assessments.
Promote a culture of thorough documentation, security awareness, accountability, and control discipline; lead effective end-user education and timely security awareness training reinforcing secure behaviors and responsible use of technology and AI tools.

QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, or related field; master’s level degree preferred but not required.
Seven (7) or more years of information technology experience with at least five (5) years managing a technology or technical team.
Demonstrated ability to work hands-on: writing code, configuring systems, and solving problems directly.
Experience implementing AI/ML solutions, workflow automation, or data engineering in a business context.
Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, security architecture, and modern enterprise technology platforms.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.
Preferred – any relevant certifications.
Preferred – experience supporting SEC-regulated or highly controlled environments (investment advisors, broker-dealers, financial services, etc.).
Preferred – familiarity with investment management and accounting technology platforms (portfolio management, market data providers, custodian integrations, etc.).

jobs.title: IT Program Manager - Clinical Portfolio - Nursing
jobs.description:
We are more than a health system. We are a belief system.
We believe wellness and sickness are both part of a lifelong partnership, and that everyone could use an expert guide. We work hard, care deeply and reach further to help people uncover their own power to be healthy. We inspire hope. We learn, grow, and achieve more – in our careers and in our communities.

Job Description Summary

The IT Program Manager is responsible for leading and managing a team of senior project managers and project managers to successfully deliver a portfolio of work across OhioHealth care sites.

The portfolio of work includes complex, cross functional system implementations, digital transformations, infrastructure modernization, facility expansions, and cybersecurity programs which align to OhioHealth’s strategic goals.

Working closely with care site operational leadership, clinical stakeholders, physicians, vendor partners, and IT leadership, the IT program manager is responsible for management, oversight, and delivery of the full portfolio of projects. This includes staffing allocation and assignment of portfolio work, management of individual contributor project managers, management of interdependencies among projects, and adherence to overall portfolio governance.

The IT Program Manager contributes to the maturity of Solution Delivery organization by identifying opportunities to improve operational efficiency through technology and process optimization. The IT Program Manager hires, mentors and coaches project management staff and provides opportunities for expanded responsibilities to enhance career growth.

This position requires exceptional leadership, verbal and written communication skills, knowledge of the healthcare industry and the ability to influence without direct authority across a large, matrixed organization.

This is Remote-OH position, with required in person meetings.

Responsibilities And Duties

Lead a team of project managers and senior project managers in the delivery of a portfolio of projects, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and adherence to the Solution Delivery framework. This includes ensuring all project managers develop and maintain project artifacts to support scope, schedule, status communication, budget, and risk management. Lead the team through organizational change, ambiguity, and competing priorities.

Drive alignment between IT project management, vendor project management, and operational leadership for enterprise-wide initiatives.

Manage resourcing needs to support delivery of the portfolio. Interview, hire, and onboard both internal and external project managers. Coach, mentor, and serve as the escalation point for project managers. Creatively solve problems, remove roadblocks, and escalate appropriately.

Manage vendor relationships to support project management staffing.

Monitor overall financial performance of the portfolio of projects, partnering with finance to align on overall actual and forecasted capital and operating expenditures.

Establish and facilitate program steering committees and governance, ensuring efficient processes and decision making with effective communication and transparency.

Build trusted partnerships across clinical, operational, financial, design and construction and technical organizations including applications, infrastructure, and security. Partner with product managers, engineers, and business leaders to modernize platforms, enable AI and analytics capabilities, improve customer/patient experiences, and continuously optimize delivery processes

Collaborate with peers to continuously improve the maturity of the Solution Delivery organization. Establish and/or optimize governance structures which promote transparency of project status, risks, and issues, and identification of needed executive decisions. Develop tools to automate manual project management deliverables and processes, improving efficiency.

Represent IT Solutions Delivery in enterprise forums and collaborate with the EPMO to drive project success.

Translate business goals into executable roadmaps and coordinating cross-functional teams across Product, Engineering, Data & Analytics, and business operations to deliver measurable outcomes.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's DegreePMP - Project Management Professional - Project Management Institute

Additional Job Description

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field or equivalent experience
10+ years of progressive experience managing complex IT programs or portfolios
PMP certification preferred
Experience with Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery models
Familiarity with IT governance, architecture, and cybersecurity frameworks

DESIRED ATTRIBUTES

Experience in Nursing Healthcare IT environments, with previous Epic experience
Demonstrated success leading project managers who support enterprise-scale IT initiatives (e.g., EHR implementations, cloud migrations, M&A integrations, new facility establishment)
Strong executive presence and ability to influence across technical and non-technical stakeholders
Expert level experience with tools such as Smartsheet, ServiceNow and JIRA
Balance strategic vision, business value, user experience, and technical feasibility while prioritizing work that delivers measurable outcomes
Use metrics, insights, and continuous improvement practices to guide decision-making, anticipate risks, improve delivery performance, and achieve predictable results

jobs.title: Senior IT Project Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Kontoor Brands is a portfolio of three of the world’s most iconic lifestyle, outdoor and workwear brands: Wrangler®, Lee® and Helly Hansen®. Kontoor Brands is a purpose-led organization focused on leveraging its global platform, strategic sourcing model and best-in-class supply chain to drive brand growth and deliver long- term value for its stakeholders.

Job Posting

Senior IT Project Manager

Job Summary

The Senior IT Project Manager, Project Management Office is accountable for leading large, complex and high-impact IT projects or multi-workstream programs that span business functions, regions, platforms and external partners. The role establishes the delivery strategy and governance model, integrates business and technology plans, and drives executive alignment on scope, investment, sequencing, risks and outcomes. The successful candidate must bring substantial SAP project management experience, particularly leading cross-regional SAP initiatives or delivering SAP transformation programs in a consulting or systems-integration environment. The role operates with substantial autonomy, anticipates cross-program implications, resolves ambiguity and leads recovery where delivery is at risk.

Responsibilities

Lead complex, cross-functional and multi-regional projects or programs from business case and mobilization through deployment, stabilization and benefits transition.
Lead cross-regional SAP implementation or transformation projects, coordinating business process, functional, technical, data, integration, testing, cutover and deployment teams across countries and time zones.
Define the project plans, governance structure, critical path, budget and resource model across multiple workstreams and suppliers
Direct program-level RAID, dependency, scope and change control; identify systemic risks and drive mitigation or recovery plans before milestones are affected.
Provide executive-level reporting with forward-looking insights, decisions required, scenario analysis and clear accountability for outcomes.
Partner with senior business and IT leaders to clarify outcomes, evaluate options and trade-offs, secure decisions and maintain alignment to strategic priorities.
Lead consulting partners, systems integrators and vendors against contractual deliverables, quality expectations, financial controls and integrated delivery commitments.
Coach project managers, establish delivery standards and contribute to portfolio prioritization, capacity planning and continuous improvement of the PMO.

Experience

Leadership of large, complex IT projects or multi-workstream programs across regions and functions
End-to-end SAP project management, including cross-regional SAP implementations or SAP transformation delivery in a consulting or systems-integration environment
Executive governance, financial management, consulting/vendor leadership and program recovery
Integration, testing, cutover and deployment leadership across multiple teams and geographies
Wholesale, retail, apparel or consumer products industry Enterprise on Prem / Cloud data warehouse systems (e.g, Snowflake, Databricks, Synapse, SAP SAC .. etc.)

Education

Bachelor degree in IT, Business or related field of study.
PMI Certification (Preferred)

Skills

Cross-regional SAP program leadership and executive influence
Integrated planning, financial control and dependency management
Consulting and systems-integrator delivery management
Enterprise risk management, negotiation and delivery recovery
Coaching, governance design and PMO capability building

Leadership Competencies Expected For This Role

Evolving Leader

Global Agility –
Leads diverse teams, adapts amidst ambiguity

Purposeful Integrity –
Leads with values, earns team’s trust, handles conflicts ethically

Strategic Foresight –
Connects teamwork to business strategy

Customer Centric Innovation –
Leads improvements rooted in customer needs

Urgency for Impact –
Drive priorities forward with pace and purpose

Bold Accountability –
Set high standards and model responsibility

Empowered Collaboration –
Builds inclusive teams, collaborates across functions

Why Kontoor Brands?

At Kontoor, we offer a comprehensive benefit package to fit your lifestyle. Our benefits are crafted with the same care as our products.

When our employees are healthy, secure, and well, they bring their best selves to work. Kontoor Brands supports you with a competitive benefits program that provides choice and flexibility to meet your and your family’s needs – now and in the future. We offer resources to support your physical, emotional, social, and financial wellbeing, plus benefits like discounts on our apparel. Kontoor Brands also provides four weeks of Paid Parental Leave to eligible employees who are new parents, Flexible Fridays, and Tuition Reimbursement.

We are proud to offer a workplace culture centered on equitable opportunities and a sense of belonging for all team members. Here we have a global workforce of high-performing teams that both unlocks our individual uniqueness and harnesses our collaborative talents.

. Minimum qualifications:

Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
8 years of experience in contract law and commercial contracts.
8 years of experience in establishing vendor performance management solutions (e.g., service level agreements and key performance indicators).
8 years of experience supporting global vendor operations in a leading technology company or in management consulting.

Preferred qualifications:

Experience managing a large portfolio of vendor contracts, including collecting and analyzing data to inform decision making.
Experience leading the end-to-end delivery of large-scale, cross-functional initiatives.
Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders, and experience in influencing decision-making at all levels, including executive leadership.
Ability to demonstrate problem-solving capabilities and experience in bringing structure and clarity to ambiguous situations.
Ability to skilled multitaskers a large and varied workload in a fast paced environment, and a demonstrated ability to meet strict deadlines.

About The Job

The Commercial Contracts Program Manager is a strategic role within the Strategy, Governance and and Transformation Office (SGTO) team, tasked with governing and overseeing GSRSs global vendor contracting and compliance activities, advising on vendor strategy and performance management, maintaining GSRS's large and portfolio of vendor contracts, and providing vendor managers with business operations support through the GSR Deal Desk.

In this role, you will enable GSRS teams by supporting the vendor engagement lifecycle from sourcing to performance management, by developing tailored vendor contracting and performance management solutions, and by driving contract portfolio consolidation and efficiencies through analysis of data and metrics. You will play a key role in shaping the future direction of GSRS's vendor and contracting strategy and governance.

You will work closely with GSRS colleagues and key Google stakeholders such as Legal, Global Procurement Organization and Extended Workforce Solutions, and using extensive commercial contracts and legal expertise you will be a key resource who ensures that GSRS aligns with best practice legal, compliance and performance management standards. The role will focus on delivering operational efficiency through AI-embedded models and AI-driven innovation, while maintaining high quality service standards for GSRS vendor managers globally.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $128000 - $187000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .

Guide global vendor selection, agreement negotiations, contract drafting, and compliance fulfillment across the portfolio.
Establish and execute global contract performance management solutions and vendor governance frameworks.
Monitor and resolve operational and compliance risks, ensuring contracts strictly align with legal standards and deliverables.
Support Deal Desk operations, oversee outsourced services, and design scalable, AI-enabled processes to drive efficiency.
Partner with cross-functional stakeholders and leverage data-driven insights and subject matter expertise to guide vendor decisions.

This includes staffing allocation and assignment of portfolio work, management of individual contributor project managers, management of interdependencies among projects, and adherence to overall portfolio governance.

The IT Program Manager contributes to the maturity of Solution Delivery organization by identifying opportunities to improve operational efficiency through technology and process optimization. The IT Program Manager hires, mentors and coaches project management staff and provides opportunities for expanded responsibilities to enhance career growth.

This position requires exceptional leadership, verbal and written communication skills, knowledge of the healthcare industry and the ability to influence without direct authority across a large, matrixed organization.

This is Remote-OH position, with required in person meetings.

Responsibilities And Duties

Lead a team of project managers and senior project managers in the delivery of a portfolio of projects, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and adherence to the Solution Delivery framework. This includes ensuring all project managers develop and maintain project artifacts to support scope, schedule, status communication, budget, and risk management. Lead the team through organizational change, ambiguity, and competing priorities.

Drive alignment between IT project management, vendor project management, and operational leadership for enterprise-wide initiatives.

Manage resourcing needs to support delivery of the portfolio. Interview, hire, and onboard both internal and external project managers. Coach, mentor, and serve as the escalation point for project managers. Creatively solve problems, remove roadblocks, and escalate appropriately.

Manage vendor relationships to support project management staffing.

Monitor overall financial performance of the portfolio of projects, partnering with finance to align on overall actual and forecasted capital and operating expenditures.

Establish and facilitate program steering committees and governance, ensuring efficient processes and decision making with effective communication and transparency.

Build trusted partnerships across clinical, operational, financial, design and construction and technical organizations including applications, infrastructure, and security. Partner with product managers, engineers, and business leaders to modernize platforms, enable AI and analytics capabilities, improve customer/patient experiences, and continuously optimize delivery processes

Collaborate with peers to continuously improve the maturity of the Solution Delivery organization. Establish and/or optimize governance structures which promote transparency of project status, risks, and issues, and identification of needed executive decisions. Develop tools to automate manual project management deliverables and processes, improving efficiency.

Represent IT Solutions Delivery in enterprise forums and collaborate with the EPMO to drive project success.

Translate business goals into executable roadmaps and coordinating cross-functional teams across Product, Engineering, Data & Analytics, and business operations to deliver measurable outcomes.

Who We Are

Kontoor Brands is a portfolio of three of the world’s most iconic lifestyle, outdoor and workwear brands: Wrangler®, Lee® and Helly Hansen®. Kontoor Brands is a purpose-led organization focused on leveraging its global platform, strategic sourcing model and best-in-class supply chain to drive brand growth and deliver long- term value for its stakeholders.

Job Posting

Senior IT Project Manager

Job Summary

The Senior IT Project Manager, Project Management Office is accountable for leading large, complex and high-impact IT projects or multi-workstream programs that span business functions, regions, platforms and external partners. The role establishes the delivery strategy and governance model, integrates business and technology plans, and drives executive alignment on scope, investment, sequencing, risks and outcomes. The successful candidate must bring substantial SAP project management experience, particularly leading cross-regional SAP initiatives or delivering SAP transformation programs in a consulting or systems-integration environment. The role operates with substantial autonomy, anticipates cross-program implications, resolves ambiguity and leads recovery where delivery is at risk.

Responsibilities

Lead complex, cross-functional and multi-regional projects or programs from business case and mobilization through deployment, stabilization and benefits transition.
Lead cross-regional SAP implementation or transformation projects, coordinating business process, functional, technical, data, integration, testing, cutover and deployment teams across countries and time zones.
Define the project plans, governance structure, critical path, budget and resource model across multiple workstreams and suppliers
Direct program-level RAID, dependency, scope and change control; identify systemic risks and drive mitigation or recovery plans before milestones are affected.
Provide executive-level reporting with forward-looking insights, decisions required, scenario analysis and clear accountability for outcomes.
Partner with senior business and IT leaders to clarify outcomes, evaluate options and trade-offs, secure decisions and maintain alignment to strategic priorities.
Lead consulting partners, systems integrators and vendors against contractual deliverables, quality expectations, financial controls and integrated delivery commitments.
Coach project managers, establish delivery standards and contribute to portfolio prioritization, capacity planning and continuous improvement of the PMO.

Experience

Leadership of large, complex IT projects or multi-workstream programs across regions and functions
End-to-end SAP project management, including cross-regional SAP implementations or SAP transformation delivery in a consulting or systems-integration environment
Executive governance, financial management, consulting/vendor leadership and program recovery
Integration, testing, cutover and deployment leadership across multiple teams and geographies
Wholesale, retail, apparel or consumer products industry Enterprise on Prem / Cloud data warehouse systems (e.g, Snowflake, Databricks, Synapse, SAP SAC .. etc.)

Education

Bachelor degree in IT, Business or related field of study.
PMI Certification (Preferred)

Skills

Cross-regional SAP program leadership and executive influence
Integrated planning, financial control and dependency management
Consulting and systems-integrator delivery management
Enterprise risk management, negotiation and delivery recovery
Coaching, governance design and PMO capability building

Leadership Competencies Expected For This Role

Evolving Leader

Global Agility –
Leads diverse teams, adapts amidst ambiguity

Purposeful Integrity –
Leads with values, earns team’s trust, handles conflicts ethically

Strategic Foresight –
Connects teamwork to business strategy

Customer Centric Innovation –
Leads improvements rooted in customer needs

Urgency for Impact –
Drive priorities forward with pace and purpose

Bold Accountability –
Set high standards and model responsibility

Empowered Collaboration –
Builds inclusive teams, collaborates across functions

Why Kontoor Brands?

At Kontoor, we offer a comprehensive benefit package to fit your lifestyle. Our benefits are crafted with the same care as our products.

When our employees are healthy, secure, and well, they bring their best selves to work. Kontoor Brands supports you with a competitive benefits program that provides choice and flexibility to meet your and your family’s needs – now and in the future. We offer resources to support your physical, emotional, social, and financial wellbeing, plus benefits like discounts on our apparel. Kontoor Brands also provides four weeks of Paid Parental Leave to eligible employees who are new parents, Flexible Fridays, and Tuition Reimbursement.

We are proud to offer a workplace culture centered on equitable opportunities and a sense of belonging for all team members. Here we have a global workforce of high-performing teams that both unlocks our individual uniqueness and harnesses our collaborative talents.

Preferred qualifications:

Experience managing a large portfolio of vendor contracts, including collecting and analyzing data to inform decision making.
Experience leading the end-to-end delivery of large-scale, cross-functional initiatives.

Ability to demonstrate problem-solving capabilities and experience in bringing structure and clarity to ambiguous situations.
Ability to skilled multitaskers a large and varied workload in a fast paced environment, and a demonstrated ability to meet strict deadlines.

About The Job

The Commercial Contracts Program Manager is a strategic role within the Strategy, Governance and and Transformation Office (SGTO) team, tasked with governing and overseeing GSRSs global vendor contracting and compliance activities, advising on vendor strategy and performance management, maintaining GSRS's large and portfolio of vendor contracts, and providing vendor managers with business operations support through the GSR Deal Desk.

In this role, you will enable GSRS teams by supporting the vendor engagement lifecycle from sourcing to performance management, by developing tailored vendor contracting and performance management solutions, and by driving contract portfolio consolidation and efficiencies through analysis of data and metrics. You will play a key role in shaping the future direction of GSRS's vendor and contracting strategy and governance.

You will work closely with GSRS colleagues and key Google stakeholders such as Legal, Global Procurement Organization and Extended Workforce Solutions, and using extensive commercial contracts and legal expertise you will be a key resource who ensures that GSRS aligns with best practice legal, compliance and performance management standards. The role will focus on delivering operational efficiency through AI-embedded models and AI-driven innovation, while maintaining high quality service standards for GSRS vendor managers globally.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $128000 - $187000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google .

Guide global vendor selection, agreement negotiations, contract drafting, and compliance fulfillment across the portfolio.
Establish and execute global contract performance management solutions and vendor governance frameworks.
Monitor and resolve operational and compliance risks, ensuring contracts strictly align with legal standards and deliverables.
Support Deal Desk operations, oversee outsourced services, and design scalable, AI-enabled processes to drive efficiency.
Partner with cross-functional stakeholders and leverage data-driven insights and subject matter expertise to guide vendor decisions.
